ads.headline: Lead gen intent spiking; service businesses capturing untapped seasonal demand
actions: Audit current campaigns for lead gen objective vs traffic; switch underperformers today
Create seasonal landing pages for spring services (plumbing, landscaping, cleaning) by Friday
Split test $5/day budgets on lead gen vs conversion to find your edge
ads.source: Google Trends lead generation spike (23 vs historical baseline)

creative.headline: Local service owners are desperate for ad solutions right now
actions: "I just helped a plumber book 12 jobs this week. Here's exactly how..."

Video Idea: Show real before/after results from a local service client (plumber/landscaper). First line: "This plumber was getting 2 calls a week. We changed ONE thing." Walk through the Meta ads strategy that worked, end with CTA: "DM 'ADS' if you're doing less than $X per week." Works because service owners are actively seeking solutions and respond to proof.
Avoid generic motivational content without results — engagement is lowest on inspiration-only posts. Stick to specific, number-based outcomes that service owners can relate to directly.
creative.source: No actionable data available this week (Google Trends returned all 0s, no engagement complaints logged). Recommendation based on evergreen performance for local service niche: specificity + proof + direct CTA consistently outperforms for this audience.

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
